description: Totals from the Ukraine Money Register of federal Ukraine-response money. view=stages (default): the inspectors general's made available, obligated and disbursed (outlaid) totals as printed, each with its own as-of date; acts: the five supplemental acts' made-available totals re-added clause by clause from the act text, beside SIG-OAR's table; codes: USAspending's emergency fund codes 3, 6, AAA, AAB and AAJ, where the mixed codes are split against the act text into Ukraine-only, probable and shared accounts, shown apart; places: place of performance in the award records; oversight: inspector-general and GAO findings quoted exactly with report numbers, dates and pages. Stages (made available, obligated, outlaid, announced) are never added to one another. Pentagon contracts whose own records mention Ukraine are not tied to the supplemental appropriations, and USAspending links only $0.47 billion of DoD's $121.30 billion obligated under the five codes to named awards. Words alleging loss or wrongdoing, such as fraud or diversion, appear only inside exact quotes.
